data.name: Ibraheemia
data.gender_notes: Ibraheemia is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A variant of Ibraheem, meaning protector of the prophets. Ibraheemia is a symbol of faith and loyalty to the prophets. The name Ibraheemia carries the meaning “Protector of the prophets” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ibraheemia usually hope their child will grow to embody protector of the prophets and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who has been given the responsibility of protecting the prophets and their message.
data.etymology: Ibraheemia belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector of the prophets.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibraheemia total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: إبراهيمية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من اسم النبي إبراهيم عليه السلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: إبراهيمية هو اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من اسم النبي إبراهيم عليه السلام، ويعني الإخلاص والتوحيد والانتماء إلى النبي إبراهيم عليه السلام. وقد ورد ذكر اسم إبراهيم في القرآن الكريم في عدة سور، منها سورة البقرة وسورة آل عمران وسورة النمل.

in_urdu.name: ابراہیمیہ
in_urdu.meaning: نبی ابراہیم علیہ السلام سے ماخوذ اسم
in_urdu.long_meaning: ابراہیمیہ ایک علم مؤنث ہے جو نبی ابراہیم علیہ السلام کے نام سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے خالصیت، توحید اور نبی ابراہیم علیہ السلام کی نسبت۔ قرآن کریم میں اسم ابراہیم کئی سورتوں میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے، جن میں سورہ البقرة، سورہ آل عمران اور سورہ النمل شامل ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: इब्राहिमिया
in_hindi.meaning: नबी इब्राहिम से लिया गया नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: इब्राहिमिया एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो नबी इब्राहिम से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है पवित्रता, एकेश्वरवाद और नबी इब्राहिम की संबद्धता। कुरआन में इब्राहिम का नाम कई सूरतों में उल्लेख किया गया है, जिनमें सूरह अल-बक़राह, सूरह आल इमरान और सूरह अन-नम्ल शामिल हैं।

in_pashto.name: ابراهيميہ
in_pashto.meaning: د نبي ابراهيم څخه اخستل شوی نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: ابراهيميہ يو مؤنث نوم دی چې د نبي ابراهيم څخه اخستل شوی دی. دا د خالصۍ، توحيد او د نبي ابراهيم نسبت معنی لري. په قرآن کريم کې د ابراهيم نوم په ډيرو سورتونو کې ذکر شوی دی، په شمول د سوره البقره، سوره آل عمران او سوره النمل.

in_english.name: Ibraheemia
in_english.meaning: Derived from Prophet Ibrahim's name, signifying purity and monotheism
in_english.long_meaning: Ibraheemia is a feminine name derived from the name of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham). It signifies purity, monotheism, and association with the Prophet. The name Ibrahim is mentioned in several Quranic surahs, including Al-Baqarah, Al-Imran, and An-Naml. Historically, the name has been used across Islamic cultures, symbolizing spiritual values and prophetic lineage.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ibraheemia holds a rich cultural significance for Muslims, as it connects us to the revered Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) in the Islamic tradition. Ibraheem is considered one of the major prophets in Islam, and the father of Ishmael and Isaac, who are also significant figures in the religion. The name Ibraheemia can be seen as a tribute to this important figure, and is often given to children as a sign of reverence and respect for his legacy.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Ibraheemia lies in its connection to the Prophet Ibrahim's unwavering faith and unwavering dedication to God. Ibrahim is known for his willingness to submit himself completely to God's will, even when it required great sacrifice. The name Ibraheemia serves as a reminder of this devotion, and can inspire those who bear the name to strive for a similar level of faith and commitment in their own lives. Additionally, the name Ibraheemia can be seen as a sign of being a protector of the faith, as Ibrahim protected and passed down the religious traditions to future generations.
